Roles and permissions

Build prompt

Build “Community Resource Map & Tracker” on NeoApps for a nonprofit. Provide map and list views, filters by service and hours, an update timestamp, and a stale status. Separate public service points from confidential sites and internal contact notes. The public sees approved locations and service hours. Partners update their assigned site. A coordinator approves new locations and manages visibility. Use fictional records for the demo.

Acceptance test

Change a public drop-off site to closed. Its map pin and list entry agree after the update. A staff-only shelter address is absent from public results and responses.
